title: EDHOC+OSCORE x5c (X.509 cert by value) handshake over TSCH on EMULATED nRF52840-DK

test.description: EDHOC Method 0 with X.509 cert-by-value (x5c) credentials over TSCH. Server (node 2) = RPL root + TSCH coordinator; client (node 1) associates and runs EDHOC then an OSCORE GET. X.509 cert carried in-band -> largest MSG_2/MSG_3 -> most 6LoWPAN fragments -> highest handshake latency of the three variants. UDGM lossless. PASSES on the client's end-to-end PASSED line; read 'EDHOC finished' timestamp for handshake latency.
